name: The Ranch at Rock Creek
positioning: All-inclusive guest ranch on a 19th-century homestead in a secluded Montana valley, with lodge rooms, log cabins, a restored barn and creekside glamping
best_for: Families wanting a kids club and twice-daily activities included
Anglers and outdoor lovers, with private access to Rock Creek

facts.text: The Ranch at Rock Creek is a 19th-century homestead secluded in a Montana valley.
The Ranch is all-inclusive, so guests can leave their wallets behind.
Stays include farm-to-table ranch cuisine at breakfast, lunch, social hour and dinner.
Twice-daily activities are included in the stay.
All-inclusive rates provide equipment, gear and knowledgeable guides for morning and afternoon excursions.
Year-round activities include horseback riding, the gun ranges and wildlife viewing.
Winter excursions include ice skating, cross-country skiing, snowmobiling and sledding.
Accommodations range from lodge suites and a converted historic barn to luxury log homes and canvas glamping cabins.
Granite Lodge rooms have custom-made furniture, woven textiles, frontier antiques and lavish linens.
The outdoor heated pool is open in summer, and the hot tub is open year-round.
Evening entertainment in the Silver Dollar Saloon includes billiards, karaoke, a private movie theater and four lanes of bowling.
The Ranch has a kids club called Flint's Forest Rangers.

highlights.text: Guests have four miles of private access to Rock Creek for fly fishing.
The original 19th-century barn, with its stables, tack room and hay loft, was restored into three accommodations: Stables, Wrangler and Loft.
The glamping cabins on the banks of Rock Creek are made of canvas, wood and stone, designed for sustainability.
The Granite Lodge is built and decorated in the style of the great National Park lodges.
Treatments at The Spa at Rock Creek include access to the cedar sauna and relaxation area.

considerations.text: Classic Canvas Cabins are open in spring, summer and fall.
Homesteader wagons are available from mid-May through Labor Day.
WhataHotel notes the remote location requires significant travel planning.
